Ball candidates located by connected-component analysis of a green-pixel mask ((G>150) AND (G>R+20) AND (G>B+60), scipy.ndimage.label, blobs >=8px, static blobs at (1611,208) and (11,279) excluded as fixed scene objects); every adjudication-critical frame confirmed by eye on the full frame or a 240px crop. Clip-to-source offset is 779-780 (D2-05 visual alignment); both offsets are considered wherever the +/-1 frame matters. Positions below are source-frame pixel coordinates (x,y).

adjudicationRecords.evidence: Third-pass ball tracks over source 808-822 (clip n29-n43 at offset 779) show NO ball at or near the target's paddle in either the prior bracket (1083-1150ms, src ~811.5-813.5) or the audit window (1201-1235ms, clip n36-37, src 815-817 across both offsets).
